description: Eight separate attenuators sharing one knob, so eight signals are cut by the same amount.

params.text: Multiplies every channel by the same factor, silence at the left through to the signal unchanged at the right.

inputs.text: The signal to be attenuated on that row.

outputs.text: The signal from the input on that row multiplied by LEVEL.

notes: A row passes nothing unless both its own input and its own output are patched.
Only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read and only one channel is sent out.
